decision: Choose which candidate comparisons justify a model procurement or release decision.
primary_outcome: Prespecified paired performance differences on decision-relevant tasks, adjusted across the searched comparison family.
denominator: All searched comparisons for multiplicity; all eligible paired task items for performance estimation.
independence_unit: Paired task item, with shared-source or benchmark clustering where applicable.
quality_guardrail: Full search-family accounting, practical effect size, critical task slices and procurement cost.
minimum_data: Candidate IDs, complete search history, item-level paired outcomes, task weights, comparison family and procurement assumptions.
failure_handling: Aggregate scores cannot reconstruct missing paired covariance. Report approximate inference and do not invent item-level precision.
release_rule: No selected reversal is a confirmed discovery unless it survives the appropriate family correction and practical decision threshold.
reversal: Results fail full-family correction, paired evidence contradicts the aggregate ranking, or relevant task weights change.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: Why report that none of nine reversals survives?
It prevents selection after searching 1,953 pairs from being presented as confirmatory evidence. A credible negative result can prevent a bad purchase.
What would make the conclusion stronger?
Retained paired item outcomes, a prespecified comparison family and decision-specific task weights, not more selective headline examples.
